title: Red Book
description: Less prep for the GM: a session log that records the game as you play (scenes, combats, downs, rests, loot, time, journals shown, NPCs met, level-ups and quick notes) with a summary and a reviewed player recap; a next-session board with active quests, linked NPCs, journals and scenes, open threads and your pins; a read-only scene readiness check; Session Start (scene, activate, unpause, start the log in one step); and a Who's online panel on Hub scenes. Every tool can be turned off. Works with any system; extra support for dnd5e.

recommends.reason: Its quests feed the next-session board, and its quests, travel, flights and loot rolls are logged in the session log. Its map pins are left out of the scene check.
